opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: under £100,000; generally 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget (operating/core costs) or 10-20% of project/capital costs; local community capital projects no greater than £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts. Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities. Work must be within UK or UK Overseas Territories.
opportunities.summary: Rolling grant programme open all year round with no deadlines, providing funding under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Supports charities working in Arts, Community, Education, Environment, Faith, Health, Museums and Heritage, Welfare, and Youth.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For capital or project costs, total project cost must be at least £1 million regardless of annual income. For core costs, organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million. Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation with at least one year's accounts.
opportunities.summary: Rolling grant programme for grants of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applications via Expression of Interest form, open all year round with no deadlines. Supports operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities in Arts, Community, Education, Environment, Faith, Health, Museums and Heritage, Welfare, and Youth.
